offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results; Hobby: $16/month billed yearly for 5,000 credits/month (2,500 searches). Paid-plan pay-as-you-go increments: $5 for 1,000–5,000 credits depending on plan.
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；返回 titles、descriptions、URLs，可选返回每个结果的 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots
offerings.note: 搜索结果默认包含 query-relevant Highlights；1–10 结果收费 2 credits，向上取整。

offerings.name: End-to-End ZDR
offerings.pricing: Cost: 10 credits per 10 results. Available on Enterprise plans.
offerings.output_type: 零数据保留搜索结果；Firecrawl 和上游搜索提供商均不存储 query 或 result data
offerings.note: 通过 enterprise: ["zdr"] 参数启用；若结合 scrapeOptions，也对结果抓取强制 ZDR。
